Katherine (Japanese: カレン Karen) is a from the Laverre Gym. In , she is a recurring character who first appeared in A Fashionable Battle!.

==In animation==
===Pokémon the Series===
==== ====
Katherine is a loyal to Laverre City Gym Leader Valerie. She and another Furisode Girl, Blossom, were first seen spying on and when they were looking through Valerie's fashion collection. They thought they would be perfect to participate in a fashion show of Valerie's collection and asked them to come with them. They brought them to Valerie and Katherine introduced them to her. 

Katherine reappeared in Fairy-Type Trickery!, where she followed and Valerie's Gym .

She reappeared in a flashback in Till We Compete Again!.

====Voice actors====
 

==In the core series games==
Katherine appears in Pokémon X and Y as one of the s in the Laverre Gym.

==In the spin-off games==
===Pokémon Masters EX===
 
Katherine forms a sync pair with in Pokémon Masters EX. Katherine became a playable sync pair on January 1, 2024.
